turns.text: Hi Daniel! How is your Monday starting out in Chicago? How are things going at the design firm?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey! Monday is going pretty well, actually. Busy as usual at the firm with some new project timelines, but I can't complain. The weather here in Chicago is finally starting to feel really nice.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That's great to hear. It's always nice when the spring weather cooperates. Have you and Leah had any time to enjoy it, or has her new pediatrician role been keeping her too busy?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: She's definitely busy, but she's loving the hospital. We did manage to get some outdoor time this weekend. Actually, I just got back from doing something a bit different for my exercise today. Usually, I'd head out for my standard jog along the water, but some buddies of mine hit me up to join them on the court for a casual game of hoops instead.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Oh, a game of hoops! That sounds like a fun change of pace. How did it go? Did your wrist hold up okay after that climbing fracture from a while back?

turns.text: Oh yeah, the wrist is completely fine now! No issues at all shooting or dribbling. It was actually a blast, even though I'm definitely going to be sore tomorrow. It's been a minute since I ran around like that.

turns.text: I'm glad to hear the wrist is 100% and didn't give you any trouble! It's always nice to mix up the routine when friends invite you out. Are you planning to head back to the climbing gym soon, or focusing on other things?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I definitely want to get back to climbing soon. That new gym that opened up across town is still on my list to check out. I might try to head over there next weekend if I can find the time.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: You'll have to let me know how that new gym compares to your usual spots! Have you taken your camera out lately either? I know you always enjoy capturing the city in the spring.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I actually took a few shots of the skyline yesterday evening when Leah and I were walking back from her pottery class. The light was perfect. I need to get around to editing them, though.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds beautiful. The evening light in the city is always perfect for photography. I hope you get a chance to look through those photos soon!

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thanks! Yeah, I'll definitely dive into them tonight. It's a nice way to wind down after a long day of work and running around on the court. Talk to you tomorrow!
